reason: Every unit-process table in this report is for CRUDE OIL: Tab. 5.1 onshore pipeline transport of crude oil, Tab. 5.2 offshore pipeline transport of crude oil, Tab. 5.3/5.4 pipeline construction, Tab. 6.1 produced crude oil to Swiss refineries, and Tab. 4.1 the composition of crude-oil vapours.
